premises.text: Companies cannot easily track where data goes across vendors or meet privacy compliance obligations
premises.evidence_span: there is no easy way to track what's happening with all of that data, and there's no easy way for companies to comply with their privacy obligations

premises.text: A vendor privacy intelligence layer scores vendors' practices, lawsuits, and policies from a proprietary dataset
premises.evidence_span: Osano provides a 360-degree view of each vendor's privacy practices

premises.text: A managed cookie-consent solution makes websites compliant across many countries with one line of code
premises.evidence_span: fully managed cookie consent solution, so that with one line of code, websites can immediately become compliant with the laws of 40 different countries

premises.text: A developer API lets builders embed data privacy into applications and workflows
premises.evidence_span: offers a developer API so that developers can quickly build data privacy into their applications and their workflows

premises.text: A large free-compliance user base creates an upsell path as vendor of record
premises.evidence_span: we are already their compliance vendor of record

value.text: Make data privacy compliance easy for companies
value.evidence_span: makes it easy for companies to identify which vendors are best to work with, to comply with laws like GDPR

causal_links.evidence_span: there's no easy way for companies to comply with their privacy obligations
making it easy for companies to identify where they have risk
with that one line of code, their website automatically becomes compliant
developers can quickly build data privacy into their applications and their workflows
we are already their compliance vendor of record

notes: Canonical split: one compliance pain-bundle + distinct capability premises (vendor intel, cookie consent, API) per v1.5.1 §4.1.6. Lawsuits/legislation/policy tracking folded into P2. OneTrust contrast and user counts treated as positioning/traction. Team bios and promo code excluded.
